sql:
WITH aug_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(fx_rate) AS fx_rate_aug
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
  WHERE currency = 'USD' AND period = '2026-08'
),
sep_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(fx_rate) AS fx_rate_sep
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
  WHERE currency = 'USD' AND period = '2026-09'
)
SELECT
  pl_sep.vendor_id,
  v.vendor_name,
  SUM(pl_sep.qty * pl_sep.unit_price_orig * (sep_avg.fx_rate_sep - aug_avg.fx_rate_aug)) AS vendor_fx_impact_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl_sep
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl_sep.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
CROSS JOIN aug_avg
CROSS JOIN sep_avg
WHERE pl_sep.currency = 'USD' AND pl_sep.period = '2026-09'
GROUP BY pl_sep.vendor_id, v.vendor_name
ORDER BY vendor_fx_impact_cad DESC
LIMIT 1
